steps.note: The decree sets at least 10 % fat for creme de leite.
The UHT treatment the decree describes for milk, in continuous flow, before aseptic packing; sterilised cream is packed in suitable containers.

sources.text: The fat minimum, the homogenising before sterilising and the UHT figures, which the decree gives for milk; the decree has since been replaced by Decree 9.013/2017.
